#!/bin/bash
# Minimal systemctl shim for containers without systemd as PID 1.
# Supports the subset of verbs used by the Qisutu installer.
STATE_DIR=/run/systemd-mock
mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
NOW=0
VERB=""
UNITS=()
for a in "$@"; do
    case "$a" in
        --now) NOW=1 ;;
        --quiet|--no-pager|--system|--no-ask-password|--no-block|--full|--plain) ;;
        -*) ;;
        *)
            if [ -z "$VERB" ]; then VERB="$a"; else UNITS+=("$a"); fi
            ;;
    esac
done

base() { local u="${1##*/}"; echo "${u%.service}"; }

start_one() {
    local u="$1"
    local n; n="$(base "$u")"
    case "$u" in
        *.path) return 0 ;;
        *install-complete*) return 0 ;;
    esac
    case "$n" in
        apache2) apache2ctl start >/dev/null 2>&1 || /usr/sbin/apachectl start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
        httpd)  /usr/sbin/httpd -k start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
        mariadb|mysql) service mariadb start >/dev/null 2>&1 || service mysql start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
        qisutu|qisutu-*) service "$n" start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
        *) service "$n" start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
    esac
    return 0
}
